nodes.label: laptop memory - the headless claude CLI models on the laptop

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the laptop's live memory file - evidence of what this machine believed at that date, listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 7. Headless Claude Code CLI on this laptop, verified 2026-07-17 at CLI v2.1.212. Binary at C:\Users\jocke\.local\bin\claude.exe, NOT on PATH in agent tool shells, so call it by full path; v3/eval/ragas.py already handles this. Invocation: claude.exe -p '<prompt>' --model <alias> --output-format json, subscription-billed, the RAGAS claude-* judge path. Structured output IS supported - --json-schema '<schema>' enforces a JSON Schema on the response, so the generator's {answer: str} contract and the judge verdict can both be schema-enforced; no temperature flag exists, and reproducibility is the CLI's one real gap against NIM. All four aliases verified: haiku maps to claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 (200k ctx, 32k out), sonnet to claude-sonnet-5, opus to claude-opus-4-8, fable to claude-fable-5 (1M ctx, 64k out each). Two gotchas: --bare skips keychain reads and fails with Not logged in; and headless reads stdin, so redirect it to avoid a 3s stall
